response.text: {"headline":"talk to one of your 7 paying customers today — retention beats more top-of-funnel.","recommendationMd":"you have 7 paying customers, 22 new signups, 1 draft pending, and 3 audits this week. 2 agent runs failed — worth a check after this, but not the headline.\n\npick one paying customer who signed up more than 14 days ago and book 15 minutes with them this week. ask: what almost made you cancel, and what almost made you upgrade. that conversation is worth more than another 50 signups right now."}
